div.div:
أَمْرٌ مُطِلٌّ An affair not settled, or not established. (So accord. to some copies of the S and K, expl. by the words لَيْسَ بِمُسْتَقِرٍّ: in other copies of both,
and in the O, ليس بِمُسْفِرٍ [to which I am unable to assign any probable meaning].)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
